title: Bulk selection overwrites the grouping preference with a list
reasoning: group_runs initially holds the boolean appearance preference, but bulk-selection branches reuse it for matching run dictionaries. That list is persisted as filter-settings-store.group_runs. On initialization, its truthiness determines whether aggregation is enabled, so selecting runs can silently enable or disable the user's grouping preference.
reproduction: With grouping disabled, toggle a model switch whose index matches a run's parent directory. The returned saved settings contain a nonempty list for group_runs; restoring those settings enables grouping.
recommendation: Keep the appearance boolean separate from the collection of matching runs and always persist group_runs as a boolean.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No included test checks settings types or preservation of appearance preferences across selection events.
suggestedRegressionTest: For each bulk-selection action, assert both enabled and disabled grouping preferences remain unchanged and boolean, regardless of how many runs match.
minimumFixScope: Local variable naming and saved-settings invariants in _manage_run_selection_logic.
